text: {"assertions":["A layout bug in the email renderer (notifications/email/render.py) was fixed on 2026-03-11.","The bug only manifested for traffic arriving through the corporate proxy.","The bug caused a table to overflow in the plain text part of email rendering.","The root cause was an off-by-one error in a slice bound.","The fix corrected the slice bound and added a property test to prevent regression.","The bug resulted in 15 duplicate rows per day being written.","The fix was submitted as PR #2392 on branch fix/broken-layout-1.","The bug could be reproduced by rendering the digest email template with a long subject."]}
